strings.UGC_HELP_BLOCKCANNON:
Block Cannon - Rapid construction

 Choose a colour by pressing… 
• {key_palette_up}, {key_palette_left}, {key_palette_down} and {key_palette_right} to choose from the colour palette 
• {key_weapon_custom} to 'pick' an existing colour from the world 

Then press…

• RMB - Zoom in for more accurate targeting
strings.UGC_HELP_BLOCKTOOL:
Block Tool - Quickly build bridges and stairs, or fill in holes

Choose a colour by pressing…
• {key_palette_up}, {key_palette_left}, {key_palette_down} and {key_palette_right}  to choose from the colour palette
• {key_weapon_custom} to 'pick' an existing colour from the world

Then press…
• LMB to place a single block
• LMB AND DRAG to place a line of blocks
• RMB to cancel
strings.UGC_HELP_CONSTRUCTTOOL_STEP1:
Construct Builder - Place special prefabricated structures from the library

Step 1 - Initial Placement
• LMB - choose an approximate location for the blueprint
• RMB - rotate the blueprint

• {key_carve_prefab} - carve the blueprint shape out of the world (useful for making tunnels and trenches)
strings.UGC_HELP_CONSTRUCTTOOL_STEP2:
Construct Builder
 - Step 2 - Fine Tuning

• {key_forward}, {key_left}, {key_backward} and {key_right} - nudge the blueprint horizontally
• {key_jump} / {key_crouch} - raise/lower blueprint

• LMB - finalize blueprint and build the construct
• RMB - rotate the blueprint

• {key_carve_prefab} - carve the blueprint shape out of the world (useful for making tunnels and trenches)

• {key_cancel_prefab_placement} - cancel

strings.UGC_HELP_HOVER:
New Jetpack Ability  - in the editor, you can press {key_hover} to 'hover' in mid-air. 

While hovering, use {key_jump} and {key_crouch} to move up and down, or {key_sprint} to move quickly. 

To stop hovering, simply press {key_hover} again.
strings.UGC_HELP_HOVER_OLD: Useful Tip - you can now 'hover' in mid-air by letting go of {key_jump} and holding down {key_crouch}
strings.UGC_HELP_PAINTBRUSH:
Paint the landscape the colour of your choice 

Choose a colour by pressing… 
• {key_palette_up}, {key_palette_left}, {key_palette_down} and {key_palette_right} to choose from the colour palette 
• {key_weapon_custom} to 'pick' an existing colour from the world 

Then press… 
• LMB to paint a single block 
• RMB to paint several blocks
